config.label: Private key of a funded Base wallet
config.description: Private key of a funded Base wallet. This server SPENDS REAL USDC from it with no human in the loop — use a fresh wallet funded with only what you are willing to lose, never a personal or deployer key. Only weakspot_audit needs it; the pricing, status and wallet-status tools work without one.

config.label: Hard cap in USD on any single audit (default 4, the highest tier)
config.description: Hard cap in USD on any single audit (default 4, the highest tier). Checked twice: against the tier price, and again against the amount the server actually quotes. An LLM decides when to call the paying tool, so this is the main spend control.

config.label: Base URL of the Weakspot deployment to use
config.description: Base URL of the Weakspot deployment to use. Defaults to https://weakspot.dev; override to point at staging or a self-hosted instance.

config.label: Base RPC endpoint, used only to read the wallet's USDC balance in weakspot_wallet_status
config.description: Base RPC endpoint, used only to read the wallet's USDC balance in weakspot_wallet_status. Nothing else needs it.
